sloka: मान्यो गुरुरिवाचार्यः किं मां त्वमनुशाससि ।किमेवं वाक्छ्रमं कृत्वा युक्तं विधीयताम् ।। ६.६३.२३ ।।
transliteration: mānyo gururivācāryaḥ kiṁ māṁ tvamanuśāsasi ।kimevaṁ vākchramaṁ kṛtvā yuktaṁ vidhīyatām ।। 6.63.23 ।।

translations.english: "Why do you, who are worthy of respect, instruct me like a father or teacher? These words express your cleverness in speaking. It is time to do what is appropriate now. Follow what is to be done."
translations.hindi: कम्भकर्ण को देखा ब्रह्मा बाबा भी डर गए । फिर कुम्भकण को देख और उसे लुभा कर ब्रह्मा जी ने उससे यह कहा
